record.original_question: Show that the hypersurface X = {x + x^2y + z^3 + t^2 = 0} in C^4, known to be an exotic C^3, is not biholomorphic to C^3. More generally, determine the same for other known hypersurfaces in C^n that are exotic C^(n-1)'s.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be the smooth affine complex hypersurface in C^4 defined by
   X = { (x, y, z, t) ∈ C^4 : x + x^2 y + z^3 + t^2 = 0 }.
It is known that X is diffeomorphic to R^6 and is an exotic C^3 in the algebraic category, meaning that X is not isomorphic to C^3 as an affine algebraic variety (this follows from the computation of its Makar-Limanov invariant).

(a) Decide whether X is biholomorphic to C^3 as a complex manifold; that is, determine whether there exists a biholomorphism F : X → C^3.

(b) More generally, for smooth affine hypersurfaces Y ⊂ C^n that are known to be algebraically exotic C^(n-1)'s (i.e. diffeomorphic to R^(2(n-1)) but not algebraically isomorphic to C^(n-1)), decide whether Y is biholomorphic to C^(n-1).
artifact.status_search_result: The algebraic non-isomorphism of the Koras-Russell cubic with C^3 was established by Makar-Limanov via the Makar-Limanov invariant. The holomorphic question — whether the Koras-Russell cubic threefold (or other algebraically exotic affine hypersurfaces) is biholomorphic to C^(n-1) — appears to still be open. Subsequent work (Kaliman-Kutzschebauch, Dubouloz, and others) has produced partial obstructions, such as the holomorphic automorphism group of the Koras-Russell cubic acting with exactly four orbits rather than transitively, but no full proof or disproof of biholomorphic non-equivalence to C^3 has been found in the literature search.

status_evidence.title: Koras–Russell cubic threefold - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Makar-Limanov showed the Koras–Russell cubic threefold is not isomorphic to the affine space C^3 because it admits fewer algebraic Ga-actions than C^3.
status_evidence.claim: Algebraic non-isomorphism known; biholomorphic question is distinct.

status_evidence.title: Sufficient conditions for holomorphic linearisation
status_evidence.snippet: The holomorphic automorphism group of the Koras-Russell cubic acts with precisely four orbits, in contrast to the transitivity of the action on C^3.
status_evidence.claim: Partial holomorphic obstruction, but does not settle biholomorphic equivalence.

status_evidence.title: The Zariski Cancellation Problem and related problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussion of Koras-Russell threefolds, including holomorphic questions still being investigated.
status_evidence.claim: Biholomorphic classification of exotic affine hypersurfaces remains an active topic.
